shots.image_prompt: A cramped, lived-in old Balkan apartment kitchen at night. The woman, in her early 30s with a short black bob and round glasses, wearing a mustard yellow knitted sweater, sits at a small worn wooden kitchen table, leaning forward on her elbows, looking at an old wooden tube radio in front of her. Behind her: green and white tiled backsplash, cream painted wall cabinets, a dented kettle on an old gas stove, a dish rack, a paper calendar on the wall, and a window with rain running down the glass and blurred city lights outside. The only light is a small table lamp with a pleated cream fabric shade on a brass base, warm tungsten glow on her face and hands, deep shadows in the corners, faint cold blue light from the window. Medium shot at eye level, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, a still from a European drama film, no text.
shots.video_prompt: Rain streams down the kitchen window as the camera slowly pushes in from a medium shot to a medium close-up of the woman at the table, keeping the radio and the table lamp in frame. She reaches out and gently turns the dial of the old radio; static crackles and a faint, distant melody fades in. The table lamp flickers twice, its warm light stuttering across her face. She stops turning the dial and slowly raises her eyes to the flickering lamp, and the shot ends with her looking up at it, uneasy. Soft rain patter, radio static, the quiet hum of the lamp. Natural, realistic motion, cinematic, film grain.

She turns her head slightly toward the dark hallway off screen and says quietly in Serbian: "Deda, opet je počelo." Her lips move naturally with the words, then she holds her breath and listens. Rain patter on the window, faint radio static. Natural, realistic motion, cinematic, film grain.

In the left foreground, slightly out of focus, the woman with a short black bob, round glasses and a mustard yellow knitted sweater sits at the worn wooden kitchen table, her shoulder and profile toward the camera, an old wooden tube radio beside her. In the doorway stands the old man in his late 70s with a white beard, flat grey cap and brown corduroy jacket over a checked shirt, half in shadow, his face lit by the warm lamp light, a gentle knowing smile. On the table on the right: a small table lamp with a pleated cream fabric shade on a brass base, glowing warm. shots.video_prompt: The camera slowly pushes in toward the doorway. The old man steps out of the dark hallway into the warm lamp light, rests one hand on the door frame and smiles gently at the woman. He says softly in Serbian: "Znam. To nam se javlja tvoja baka." The woman slowly turns her head toward him, her worried face softening into a small smile. The lamp flickers once more. Rain patter, the creak of the old wooden floor, faint radio static.
